articles.title: Maruti Suzuki Q2 Results: Profit falls 26% YoY to Rs 2,466 crore, but revenue rises 26%

articles.title: GST officers must prove intent to evade tax before invoking fraud provision: CBIC
articles.desc: GST officers cannot invoke fraud, wilful misstatement or suppression provisions merely because tax has not been paid or a discrepancy is found, the CBIC has clarified. Such provisions can be used only where there is specific evidence of deliberate intent to evade tax, and that evidence must be clearly set out in the show cause notice.

articles.title: US IPO Process: How companies navigate the road to Wall Street listing

The process typically takes three to six months, with market conditions and investor demand influencing the outcome.

articles.title: US, Brazil and Israel elections put India’s trade worth billions in focus

The US is close to finalizing a trade pact, which could affect Indian exports significantly. Brazil's growing economic relationship with India is leading to ambitious trade targets between the two nations. In Israel, the continuation of defense cooperation and negotiations for a free trade agreement are crucial for India.

articles.title: Mankind Pharma shares jump 8% as Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 716 crore
articles.desc: Mankind Pharma shares jumped nearly 8% after the company reported a 38% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 716 crore. Revenue grew 17%, supported by domestic and export growth, while EBITDA margins expanded 210 basis points.

articles.title: Jio’s big-bang listing may give it stock market’s No.2 crown after Reliance Industries
articles.desc: Jio Platforms could overtake Bharti Airtel to become India’s second-largest listed company after its October 28 debut, with a 22% grey market premium implying a market capitalisation of Rs 12.5 lakh crore. Its Rs 30,213-crore IPO drew 22.2 times subscription, while brokerages highlighted growth opportunities in broadband, enterprise technology and AI.

articles.title: A banking giant, a battered stock: Can HDFC Bank’s new chief turn the tide?
Jefferies says Vodafone Idea shares can soar 143% in bull case scenario. 3 reasons why brokerage is upbeat
articles.desc: Jefferies sees a wide risk-reward range for Vodafone Idea, forecasting up to 143% upside in its bull case and 25% downside in its bear case. Network expansion, improving subscriber trends and tariff hikes could support strong revenue and EBITDA growth.

articles.title: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
articles.desc: Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.

articles.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks slip as technology shares extend losses
articles.desc: China and Hong Kong stocks edged lower as weakness in technology and AI-related shares outweighed faster industrial-profit growth and fresh liquidity support from China’s central bank.

articles.title: Will the Budget pass Burnham's Makerfield test?
articles.desc: People in the prime minister's constituency say rising costs are squeezing household finances.

articles.title: Alibaba AI model secretly tried to reach Beijing server in test, rival Cohere says
articles.desc: Canadian AI company Cohere said on Monday one of Alibaba's Qwen AI models tried to send data to an Alibaba Cloud storage server in Beijing during a security test. The model made the attempt even though its own reasoning indicated it would not do such a thing, Cohere said.

articles.title: Jio Platforms shares to list on BSE, NSE tomorrow;  GMP signals 22% premium
articles.desc: Jio Platforms shares are set to list on the BSE and NSE on October 28, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 22%. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was subscribed 22.19 times, led by strong institutional demand. Investors will watch the listing amid Jio’s growth ambitions and financial performance.

articles.title: First-time buyers hoping for help from the Budget
articles.desc: Aspiring homeowners say rent, rising costs and house prices are delaying plans to buy.

articles.title: Why are investors selling Neocloud stocks despite AI demand?
articles.desc: AI-focused neocloud stocks came under pressure after Elon Musk warned of widespread failures and industry consolidation. Heavy debt, rising financing costs, mounting losses and doubts over sustainable returns are intensifying scrutiny of the AI infrastructure boom.

articles.title: Budget 2026: 'Surrey is a lovely place - but it can be stressful'
articles.desc: Ahead of the Budget, residents tell BBC Radio Surrey their experiences of the cost-of living crisis.

articles.title: Australia warns of 'unprecedented' AI threat
articles.desc: Artificial intelligence poses an "unprecedented" threat as foreign governments turn it loose to hack computer networks and critical infrastructure, Australia's cyber security agency warned on Tuesday. "This activity extends beyond government networks, and includes critical infrastructure entities, private businesses and individuals."

articles.title: Risks spelled out for Anthropic investors include possible harms from runaway AI
articles.desc: The risks laid out by the San Francisco company in its filing Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission included discussion of bad actors potentially using AI models to build deadly weapons or the technology itself going rogue with untold consequences.

articles.title: India-Russia trade grew by 20 per cent this year: Russian State Duma Chairman
articles.desc: India imported $44.9 billion of Russian goods during the period, including $36 billion in crude oil. Indian exports to Russia totaled $2.8 billion, with Moscow increasing purchases of chemicals, electrical goods, medical equipment, seafood, tea, and spices.

articles.title: Sugar season 2026–27 begins on schedule, nearly 107 mills commence operations across India: ISMA
articles.desc: In Maharashtra, the country’s largest sugar-producing state, close to 87 mills have commenced operations. More mills are expected to start in the coming week as cane harvesting gathers pace.

articles.title: India-US Trade Facilitation Portal records 3,500 registrations within months of launch: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Around 3,500 registrations have been recorded on the India-US Trade Facilitation Portal since its launch. This platform aims to connect Indian exporters with US-based buyers for improved trade relationships. It is particularly beneficial for micro, small and medium enterprises seeking market expansion.

articles.title: Wheat sowing lags at 11,000 hectare so far amid deficient monsoon; rabi acreage down
articles.desc: Wheat sowing in India has reached 11,000 hectares as of October 23, against 27,000 hectares a year earlier, as a deficient southwest monsoon raises concerns over soil moisture and irrigation availability. Punjab and Rajasthan face particular risks, while overall rabi crop coverage has also fallen, Agriculture Ministry data showed.

articles.title: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos
articles.desc: On Monday, Instagram announced that it is testing out video lengths of up to 90 minutes with select creators in the US.

articles.title: RBI steps up liquidity support as tighter cash conditions push up borrowing rates: Report
articles.desc: Tightening liquidity in the banking system has pushed up short-term borrowing rates, prompting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to inject funds into banks, according to an ICICI Bank report. Meanwhile, rising oil prices and concerns over inflation are putting pressure on government bond yields. The report expects the 10-year benchmark bond yield to trade between 7.40% and 7.60% in the near term.

articles.title: DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal
articles.desc: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO by the numbers, from a possible valuation in the trillions to surging revenue
articles.desc: The artificial intelligence lab filed papers Monday setting up a Wall Street debut next month, ahead of its chief rival OpenAI and just months after SpaceX set records in June with an initial public offering that raised $86 billion.

articles.title: Why Walmart would rather keep Flipkart private, for now
articles.desc: Over the past few weeks, much has been written about former employees of the online commerce company writing to Walmart's board, asking for liquidity on the stock options they were granted 10 to 15 years ago. On October 1, at least eight former senior executives, among them former Myntra CEO Mukesh Bansal and former chief business officer Ankit Nagori, wrote to Walmart chairman Gregory Penner, other board members and Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, seeking a complete exit for all former employees holding vested options.

articles.title: VerSe valuation sinks; Paytm Q2 profit rises
articles.desc: Happy Tuesday! Dailyhunt parent VerSe Innovation’s valuation has taken a sharp hit. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: Govt seeks investor and expert views on LTCG and STT as it reviews capital market levies amid FPI exodus
articles.desc: The government has initiated a reassessment of long-term capital gains tax and securities transaction tax. Stakeholders, including investors and tax experts, have been consulted for their views. The debate has gained momentum due to significant outflows of foreign portfolio investments. Current taxation methods may affect the attractiveness of Indian equities compared to global markets. The upcoming budget provides an opportunity to revisit these tax regulations.

articles.title: Business Daily
articles.desc: After decades of ultra-cheap money, the cost of borrowing in Japan is rising

articles.title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know
articles.desc: Anthropic’s IPO prospectus is 355 pages and full of never before disclosed company information.

articles.title: Cotton shortage set to worsen as new deals drive export demand
articles.desc: The impact of El Nino weather conditions could further hurt domestic production, expected to fall by 3.4% to a new low in the 2026-27 crop year ended September. Cotton imports hit a record high in 2025-26 to an estimated 7.1 million bales of 170 kilograms compared to last year's imports of 5.74 million bales. Prices have also risen more than 7% in the past month.

articles.title: India and US fine-tune trade pact after concluding most talks, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India and the United States have nearly finalized discussions regarding a proposed bilateral trade agreement. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal mentioned that fine-tuning of the agreement is currently underway. This follows remarks from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio about a few remaining details. Initially, the US removed a penalty on Indian goods related to Russian oil purchases.

articles.title: FTA with India will be a game changer in supply chain management: EU ambassador to India
articles.desc: EU ambassador to India Jean-Eric Paquet further said, "We are creating an economic space across India and the European internal market. That is what is being established, creating a long-term perspective and reliability for economic operators, which will obviously build on very significant trade already."

articles.title: EU can learn from India on cutting regulatory burden, says Piyush Goyal as Dutch minister rules out CBAM rethink
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal addressed the India-Netherlands Business Forum, highlighting India's deregulation efforts to reduce burdens on businesses. He asserted that the EU could learn from India's successful approach to regulatory matters. Dutch Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma acknowledged the importance of necessary regulations but emphasized the need to review those that hinder trade. He reiterated that climate and product safety regulations are crucial for European consumers.

articles.title: Israel and the US are both going to the polls - the consequences will be global
articles.desc: The next fortnight sees two elections on different continents. The outcomes will shape geopolitics and the global economy, writes James Landale
